## Problem

What user-visible problem does this change solve?

## Changes

- Describe the focused change here.

## Verification

- [ ] Backend tests pass.
- [ ] Relevant browser or Electron tests pass.
- [ ] New behavior has regression coverage.
- [ ] UI changes include synthetic-data screenshots.
- [ ] Documentation and CHANGELOG are updated when needed.

## Privacy and evidence review

- [ ] No credentials, browser profiles, lead records, campaign content or local paths are included.
- [ ] New data fields retain their source and distinguish observed facts from assumptions.
- [ ] The change does not bypass authentication, CAPTCHAs, paywalls, robots rules, rate limits or access controls.
- [ ] External communication remains approval-gated.
